title: The kernel step for already bounded objects of the constructible weak Serre hull
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ isomorphic to one of $A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E$, where $A$ is finite discrete and killed by a power of $\ell$ and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, using continuous functions and the given topologies [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let $X$ be affine [def-pc-scheme]. Use ordinary internal $\Lambda_X$-modules and their uncompleted derived sections on the small pro-etale site [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-sfb-condensed-module-sections, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Suppose every affine etale $V\to X$ has locally torsion etale cohomological dimension at most $d$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. Let $M,N$ belong to the weak Serre coproduct hull of finite constant scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Assume separately for both $M$ and $N$ that $H^r(R\Gamma(X,M[0]))=H^r(R\Gamma(X,N[0]))=0$ for all $r>d+2$. For every actual module map $f:M\to N$, the actual abelian kernel $K=\ker(f)$ satisfies $H^q(R\Gamma(X,K[0]))=0$ for $q>d+2$. The input bounds are genuine hypotheses; no assertion for an arbitrary object of the hull is included. No Noetherianity, completion, or filtered finite-heart presentation is assumed. Empty $X$, zero coefficients, zero maps and isomorphisms are included.

source.place: Paragraph (2), first paragraph, affine coefficient-transfer obligation; the arbitrary-map relation-resolution step isolated in lem-sfb-weak-serre-supported-derived-generation. Agent formulation; exact full-generality reference WANTED.

proof.text: In the finite discrete branch, transport the actual kernel along the coefficient isomorphism and apply the finite discrete Serre-heart bound, using kernel closure of the weak Serre coproduct hull. The input vanishing assumptions are unnecessary in this branch.

For the remaining topological coefficients use 0 -> ker f -> M -> coim f -> 0. If q>d+3, coimage vanishing in degree q-1 and the source bound in degree q imply kernel vanishing by exactness at H^q(ker f).

For q=d+3, critical-degree surjectivity makes the connecting map H^(d+2)(coim f) -> H^(d+3)(ker f) zero. Its composite with the epimorphism from H^(d+2)(M) is zero by the long exact sequence. The other outgoing map has zero target by the source bound. Exactness gives kernel vanishing. Integer arithmetic exhausts q>d+2.

proof_origin.place: E6: finite discrete comparison and exact-sequence assembly from strict coimage vanishing plus critical coimage surjectivity. The geometric comparison substeps remain open.

theorem torsionCd_bounded_serre_kernel
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (d : ℕ)
    (hcd : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsAffine V] [Etale v],
      V.HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE d)
    (M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hM : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) M)
    (hN : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) N)
    (hMb : ∀ q : ℤ, (d : ℤ) + 2 < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))))
    (hNb : ∀ q : ℤ, (d : ℤ) + 2 < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))))
    (q : ℤ) (hq : (d : ℤ) + 2 < q) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (kernel f))))
